# Ding

> Spring-physics toast notifications for React, Svelte 5, Vue 3 and plain DOM. Zero dependencies. Styles are injected from JS, so there is no stylesheet to import. Human docs: /docs.html. Release notes with live demos: /changelog/

## Install

- React: `npm i @yusufceng1z/ding-react`
- Svelte 5: `npm i @yusufceng1z/ding-svelte`
- Vue 3 / Nuxt: `npm i @yusufceng1z/ding-vue`
- Vanilla: `npm i @yusufceng1z/ding`
- shadcn/ui (React): `npx shadcn@latest add @ding/ding`

## Setup

Render the toaster once, near the root.

- React: `import { Toaster, toast } from '@yusufceng1z/ding-react'` then `<Toaster position="top-center" theme="system" />`
- React with the Next.js App Router: the package ships `"use client"`, so render `Toaster` directly in `app/layout.tsx` (a server component is fine). Call `toast` from client components only. Guide: /nextjs-toast/
- Svelte 5: `import { Toaster, toast } from '@yusufceng1z/ding-svelte'` then `<Toaster position="top-center" theme="system" />`
- Vue 3: `import { Toaster, toast } from '@yusufceng1z/ding-vue'` then `<Toaster position="top-center" theme="system" />`. In Nuxt render it in `app.vue`; it renders nothing on the server
- Vanilla: `import { mountToaster, toast } from '@yusufceng1z/ding'` then `const unmount = mountToaster({ position, theme, dir })`
- Strict CSP (`style-src` without `'unsafe-inline'`): pass the page's nonce, `<Toaster nonce={nonce} />` (Vue: `:nonce="nonce"`) or `mountToaster({ nonce })`. Only the injected stylesheet needs it

## API

All calls return the toast id. Import `toast` from the package.

- `toast.success(title, options?)`, `toast.error`, `toast.warning`, `toast.info`, `toast.loading`
- `toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error })` morphs one toast from loading to the result
- `toast.update(id, patch)` changes a live toast in place. A patch may set title, description, type, duration, progress, action, secondary, meta, image. `null` removes action, secondary, meta, image and progress.
- `toast.dismiss(id?)` closes one toast, or all
- `toast.configure({ position, theme, dir, labels, sound, volume })`. `labels: { region, dismiss }` sets the accessible names of the region and the close button (English by default). `dir: 'ltr' | 'rtl'` sets the direction of the toast viewport; leave it out to follow the page

Options: `description`, `action { label, onClick }`, `secondary { label, onClick }`, `image` (avatar URL), `meta` (small trailing text), `progress` (0 to 1), `duration` (ms, 0 stays until dismissed), `id`.

`onClick` may return a patch. The toast then morphs in place instead of closing. A returned patch removes the buttons unless it names them again.

Positions: top-left, top-center, top-right, top-start, top-end, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right, bottom-start, bottom-end. `start` / `end` follow the reading direction (the right edge in RTL); `left` / `right` are always the physical edge. Themes: system, light, dark.

## Styling

Colors and corner radius are CSS variables. Set them in your own stylesheet on `.tst-viewport`: `--tst-radius` (default 22px), `--tst-bg`, `--tst-fg`, `--tst-success`, `--tst-error`, `--tst-warning`, `--tst-info`. The color defaults use `light-dark()`, so a single value applies to both themes. Example: `.tst-viewport { --tst-radius: 8px; --tst-bg: #1e3a8a; --tst-fg: #fff; }`

Advanced: `--tst-size` (44px), `--tst-pad` (16px), `--tst-shadow`, `--tst-enter-scale`; font is set on `.tst-viewport`. Filled toast: override `--fill`, `--on`, `--c` on `.tst-viewport .tst[data-type=error]`. Theme: follows the system; pass `theme` to Toaster or `toast.configure({ theme })` when the site has its own switch. Colors may use `light-dark(a, b)`. Per-toast style: option `className`, styled as `.tst.your-class`. `toast.configure({ springs: { enter: { stiffness, damping } } })` retunes motion (enter, morph, stack). `toast.configure({ icons: { success: ['<svg path d>', ...] } })` replaces status icons (24x24 stroke paths, first is the ring; keep 3 paths for warning and info).

## Sound

Off by default. `toast.configure({ sound: true, volume: 0.5 })` plays a soft built-in mallet tone per status, no audio files (success rises, error falls, warning double-taps, info is one note). Volume is 0 to 1. Loading is silent. Browsers keep audio locked until a click or key press, so the first sound must follow one.

To use another sound library, pass a function: `toast.configure({ sound: (type) => play(type) })`. It is called with `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info` or `loading`, once per new toast and once per status change. Progress updates make no sound.

## Behavior

- One toast is shown at a time. A new call morphs the live toast instead of stacking. Only the newest caller can update it, so a late result from an older call is ignored.
- Repeating an identical toast adds a counter (×2) instead of a new toast.
- Errors, loading and toasts with an action stay until dismissed. Other toasts close after 5 seconds. Hover and keyboard focus pause the timer.
- Escape dismisses. Alt+T moves focus into the toast.
- Messages go through persistent live regions: errors assertive, everything else polite.
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Mirrors in right-to-left pages (icon, text reveal, countdown line, error shake). The plain DOM and Vue toasters live in `document.body` and only see `<html dir>`; for a `dir` set on an inner container pass it yourself: `<Toaster dir="rtl" />` or `mountToaster({ dir: 'rtl' })`
